title: Probability for a constant outcome
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine, $C$ an initial configuration, and $C_f$ a configuration. Suppose every choice word $u$ of length $S$ leads from $C$ to $C_f$. For any decidable configuration property $Q$, the probability that $Q$ holds after a uniformly chosen length-$S$ run from $C$ is $1$ if $Q(C_f)$ holds and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Every choice word of length $S$ leads from $C$ to $C_f
